title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy levels E_j.

title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the wave functions |E_j⟩.

title: Eigenvalue Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the eigenvalues from the operator A.

title: Matrix Representation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly represent the operator A in matrix form.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the periodic boundary conditions applied to the system.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the wave functions are normalized.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the energy expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
